scripts.build:monkey_patch:dev: rm -rf npm-dist && npx webpack --config webpack.config.monkey_patch.cjs --mode development && cp src/monkey_patch/package.json npm-dist/ && cp src/monkey_patch/index.d.ts npm-dist/
scripts.build:monkey_patch: rm -rf npm-dist && npx webpack --config webpack.config.monkey_patch.cjs --mode production && cp src/monkey_patch/package.json npm-dist/ && cp src/monkey_patch/index.d.ts npm-dist/
scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/devtools_page.html dist/devtools_page.html && cp src/assets/devtools_page_icon.ico dist/assets/devtools_page_icon.ico && cp src/assets/devtools_page_icon-28px.ico dist/assets/devtools_page_icon-28px.ico
scripts.build:extension:dev: rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail 'yarn build:lib:dev' 'yarn build:vite:dev'
scripts.build:extension:dev:once: rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail 'yarn build:lib:dev:once' 'yarn build:vite:dev'
scripts.build:extension:dev:watch: rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others --names 'LIB,VITE' 'yarn build:lib:dev' 'yarn build:vite:dev --watch'
scripts.build:extension: rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail 'yarn build:lib' 'yarn build:vite'
scripts.playground: yarn build:monkey_patch && yarn --cwd playground install --force && yarn --cwd playground dev
scripts.playground:build: yarn build:monkey_patch && yarn --cwd playground install --force && yarn --cwd playground build
scripts.pack:debug: yarn build:monkey_patch && cd npm-dist && npm pack
scripts.publish:debug:beta:dry: yarn build:monkey_patch && cd npm-dist && npm publish --tag beta --dry-run
scripts.publish:debug:beta: yarn build:monkey_patch && cd npm-dist && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.publish:debug:latest: yarn build:monkey_patch && cd npm-dist && npm publish --tag latest
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && concurrently --kill-others --names 'LIB,VITE,WATCH' 'yarn build:lib:dev' 'yarn build:vite:dev' 'yarn build:vite:dev --watch'
scripts.dev:prod: rm -rf dist && concurrently --kill-others --names 'LIB,VITE,WATCH' 'yarn build:lib' 'yarn build:vite' 'yarn build:vite --watch'
scripts.test:playground:sync: yarn build:monkey_patch && mkdir -p playground/node_modules/react-hooks-global-states-debug && cp npm-dist/debug.js npm-dist/index.d.ts npm-dist/package.json playground/node_modules/react-hooks-global-states-debug/ && rm -rf playground/node_modules/.vite
scripts.test:playground: yarn test:playground:sync && yarn --cwd playground test && yarn --cwd playground test:no-patch

scriptsInfo.build:monkey_patch:dev: Development build of the debug package into ./npm-dist (unminified, source maps), then copies its package.json and index.d.ts into the output.
scriptsInfo.build:monkey_patch: Production build of the debug package (react-hooks-global-states-debug) into ./npm-dist, then copies its package.json and index.d.ts into the output.
scriptsInfo.build:lib:dev: Development build of the extension's webpack bundles (content_script + devtools_page) into ./dist/lib.
scriptsInfo.build:lib: Production build of the extension's webpack bundles (content_script + devtools_page) into ./dist/lib.
scriptsInfo.copy:static: Copy the extension's static files (manifest.json, devtools_page.html, icons) from src into ./dist. Runs before the lib/vite builds so they are always present and survive watch rebuilds.
scriptsInfo.build:vite:dev: Type-check (tsc -b) then Vite development build of the panel UI (index/main_tab) into ./dist.
scriptsInfo.build:vite: Type-check (tsc -b) then Vite production build of the panel UI (index/main_tab) into ./dist.
scriptsInfo.build:extension:dev: Clean ./dist, then run the lib and vite dev builds in parallel to produce a full development extension.
scriptsInfo.build:extension:dev:watch: Clean ./dist, then watch both the webpack lib bundles and the vite panel UI, rebuilding into ./dist on every change. Reload the extension in chrome://extensions to pick up changes.
scriptsInfo.build:extension: Clean ./dist, then run the lib and vite production builds in parallel to produce a full production extension.
scriptsInfo.build: Alias for build:extension (default production extension build).
scriptsInfo.build:all:dev: Build both the development extension and the development debug package in parallel.
scriptsInfo.build:all: Build both the production extension and the production debug package in parallel.
scriptsInfo.playground: Build the debug package, install the playground's dependencies, and start its Vite dev server (http://localhost:5199). One-shot command to run the playground from the repo root.
scriptsInfo.playground:dev: Start the playground's Vite dev server only (assumes deps are already installed and npm-dist is built).
scriptsInfo.playground:build: Build the debug package, install the playground's dependencies, and produce a production build of the playground.
scriptsInfo.pack:debug: Build the debug package and run `npm pack` from ./npm-dist to produce a local .tgz tarball for testing before publishing.
scriptsInfo.publish:debug:beta:dry: Build the debug package and run `npm publish --tag beta --dry-run` from ./npm-dist. Inspects the tarball contents without publishing anything.
scriptsInfo.publish:debug:beta: Build the debug package and publish it to npm under the `beta` tag (requires `npm login`). Irreversible per version.
scriptsInfo.publish:debug:latest: Build the debug package and publish it to npm under the `latest` tag (requires `npm login`). Irreversible per version.
scriptsInfo.format: Format the whole project with Prettier (writes changes in place).
scriptsInfo.lint:fix: Format with Prettier, then run ESLint with --fix to auto-fix the autofixable lint problems. Rules with no autofix (e.g. tailwindcss/no-arbitrary-value) are still reported and must be fixed by hand.
scriptsInfo.start: Run the Vite dev server in development mode (panel UI only, not loaded as an extension).
scriptsInfo.preview: Preview the production Vite build locally.
scriptsInfo.preview:dev: Build the panel UI in development mode and preview the local mock page (index.local.html -> src/index.dev.tsx). Accepts a mock example arg, e.g. `yarn preview:dev todo` or `yarn preview:dev devtools` (default: devtools). Not part of the production build.
scriptsInfo.zip: Zip the built ./dist folder into react-hooks-global-states-dev-tools.zip (for distribution / Chrome Web Store upload).
scriptsInfo.ts-check: Type-check the whole project with `tsc -b` (no emit beyond build info).
scriptsInfo.test:ui: Run Vitest with the browser UI.
scriptsInfo.test:run: Run the full Vitest suite once and exit.
scriptsInfo.test:coverage: Run the suite once and generate a coverage report.
scriptsInfo.test:coverage:open: Generate the coverage report and open the HTML report in the browser.
scriptsInfo.test:changed: Run only tests related to changed files, once.
